seed_world_description: You already know as much about me as I do myself... What more can I say... I was born I don't know where... From early childhood I was a slave to a professor in the Snake Quarter. I studied, I developed. For my merits, I rose to the position of assistant... That's all I can say about myself.
seed_family_description: I don't remember my relatives at all. I was still an infant when I came here. I was raised by the professor's servants. If you want, you can consider them my family. Although, due to the professor's penchant for various experiments, I had so many caregivers that I can hardly single out any one of them...
seed_occupation_description: As for my skills... I have probably achieved considerable success in medicine and sorcery. And this saved my life, as my abilities proved useful to my former master. Otherwise, I am an ordinary woman. I do some things well, some not so well. Recently I started to understand something about mechanics. So I'm a capable student, if you're wondering...
